verdict.rationale: Retell's 'Conductor' is documented as a first-party AI assistant that drafts agents from plain-English descriptions, edits prompts/flows on request, runs simulation test cases, and inspects knowledge bases/analytics before applying changes — directly matching the story's ask for AI-assisted prompt/flow/test generation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of Conductor's output quality (community evidence only covers live call behavior, not the Conductor authoring tool itself).
